name: Fenix A319 / A320 / A321
notes: Fenix thrust levers are driven by L:A_FC_THROTTLE_LEFT_INPUT / RIGHT_INPUT (0 = full reverse, 1 = idle reverse, 2 = idle, 3 = CLB, 4 = FLX/MCT, 5 = TOGA). Idle, reverse, FLX/MCT and TOGA are copied from the recording; between idle and CLB the levers are steered so N1 follows the recording (autothrust moves N1 while the levers sit in CLB). The Fenix runs its own engine model, so N1 can't be written directly (spool off). Start the replay with the engines running - ENGINE_AUTO_START is ignored by the Fenix. Flight controls are not replayed: the fly-by-wire computers treat a replayed stick input as a roll/pitch-rate demand and drive ailerons and roll spoilers to full deflection on one side.
